difficulty: Two-page laboratory report: letterhead, boxed 4-column key/value panel, results tables with two-line top-aligned cells and vertically centred status cells, table footnote, roman-numeral hanging list, side-by-side signature boxes.
title: Water Quality Test Report
key_sentences: This report presents the results of the chemical and microbiological analysis of one drinking-water sample.
The sample was received in good condition and analysed within 24 hours of collection.
The sample meets the drinking-water standard for all parameters except iron, which exceeds the limit of 0.20 mg/l.
The elevated iron content does not pose a health risk, but it can cause staining and a metallic taste.
The results relate only to the sample as received.

list_items.text: i. Flush the kitchen tap for two minutes before drawing water for drinking.
ii. Inspect the internal pipework of the village hall for corrosion.
iii. Repeat the iron analysis on a new sample after the inspection.

furniture: Accredited testing · 22 Mill Lane, Ashford AS1 4QT
notes: Table 1 is the boxed key/value panel (4 columns, label/value pairs; no header row). Table 2 (chemical analysis) has a header row (its "Result †" header cell carries the dagger); cells of the first two columns have two lines (joined with one space) and are TOP-aligned, while the "Status" cells are vertically CENTRED. Subscript digits in "NO3" and "NH4" are plain digits in the expected text. Table 3 (microbiology) is a small full grid. The footnote under Table 1 starts with a dagger † and is small body text; it is not a key sentence. List "Recommendations": typed lowercase roman "i." "ii." "iii." with hanging indent. The two signature boxes at the end are SIDE BY SIDE (reading order left then right) and are not key sentences. Letterhead lines are furniture. Footers on each page: "Report WQ-2026-0382 · Page 1 of 2" and "Report WQ-2026-0382 · Page 2 of 2".
